description: Java class ContentJsonEvents handling content association operations such as get, move, delete, and related helper methods within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ContentJsonEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing content associations, including retrieval, movement, and deletion of content links within the OFBiz content management system.

methods.name: getContentAssocs
methods.description: Retrieves and returns a sorted list of content associations for a given content ID, outputting JSON.

methods.name: moveContent
methods.description: Moves a content association from one content ID to another, updating relevant database entries and returning the updated node as JSON.

methods.name: deleteContent
methods.description: Deletes content associations and related web path aliases for a specified content ID.

methods.name: deleteContent
methods.description: Helper method to delete associations and aliases for a given content ID.

methods.name: deleteWebPathAliases
methods.description: Recursively deletes web path aliases associated with a content ID.

methods.name: getTreeNode
methods.description: Constructs a tree node representation of a content association, including content name and attributes.
